2 a) Quash the FIR against the petitioners 1 and 2 who are accused No. 2 and 3 as per the FIR in Cr.No.305/2018 registered before the Hennur Police Station, Bangalore which is now pending NC: 2024:KHC:14659 on the file of the XI ACMM, Mayo Hall,
Bangalore, for the offences U/s 498-A of IPC, r/w 34 of IPC and Section 4 of DP Act,
and consequentially further investigation in Crime No. 305/2018 in the interest of justice and equity.
b) Such other relief's as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the facts and circumstances of the case.
2. A memo dated 10.4.2024 has been filed and signed by learned counsel for the petitioner, which reads as under Memo

entities.text: Kulsum Rahim vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Advocate for the petitioner submits that, the above petition may pleased be Dismiss, as not pressed.

It is submitted that, on the file oof the XIth A.C.M.M. Mayo Hall at Bangalore in C.C.No.51489/2021 pending disposal of the same, the petitioners and the 2nd respondent have mutually compromised and the 2nd respondent, by accepting one Time Alimony from her Husband (A-1) in C.C.No.51489/2021 and accordingly the Trial Court at Below, the learned magistrate (XIth A.C.M.M.) has passed an order of Acquittal, Acquitting the Petitioners, vide Judgment Dated 05/06/2023.
Wherefore it is humbly prayed that, the Hon'ble Court may pleased be Dismiss the above petition has not pressed in the interest of justice.
3. Along with the memo, the order/judgment in CC No.51489/2024 as also been enclosed indicating that accused No.1 to 3 have been acquitted for the offences stated therein.
In that view of the matter, accepting the memo and submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petition is dismissed as infructuous.
